name: Afrobeat 12/8 bell kit
desc: Compound 12/8 afrobeat engine: a euclid (7,12) gankogui bell rotating Reich-style over the cowbell, TR707 kick on the four dotted pulses, rotating Tony-Allen ghost snares and triplet hats breathing under a slow filter sweep.

code.full: stack(s('cb(7,12,<0 2 4 6>)').gain(${bell}).lpf(${cut}).room(.12), s('bd(4,12)').bank('RolandTR707').gain(${gain}).shape(${drive}), s('sd(5,12,<2 4>)').bank('RolandTR707').gain(${snare}), s('[hh hh hh]*4').bank('RolandTR707').gain('[0.7 0.4 0.5]*4').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.5,${cut}).slow(16)).every(4, x=>x.fast(2))).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s('cb(7,12,<0 2 4 6>)').gain(${bell}).lpf(${cut}).room(.12), s('<[bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd]>').bank('RolandTR707').gain(${gain}).shape(${drive}), s('sd(5,12,<0 3 6 9>)').bank('RolandTR707').gain(${snare}), s('[hh hh hh]*4').bank('RolandTR707').gain('[0.8 0.45 0.6]*4').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}).slow(12)).every(4, x=>x.fast(2))).orbit(1).play()
